item.title: Admin Post - Info - Open
item.content:encoded:
Moved to Questions Desk since it's a query about part of the writing process, though authors really should not be making additional "advertisement" threads to ask for critique, as that generates spam.

Author, if you're having trouble getting further replies on a thread, you can look at this thread for options to contact reviewers: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews

Please note that you can also use the IRC chatroom #thecritters to seek draft feedback without needing greenlights.

item.title: In need of help with refinement of SCP (Get. Keep. Shelter.)
item.content:encoded:
I requested a greenlight for my SCP idea (http://www.scpwiki.com/forum/t-13929748/requesting-greenlight-for-scp-get-keep-shelter#post-4843271)

I would like somebody to help this process by reviewing a sandbox page that I have written regarding the overall gist of my SCP.
If you would like to participate, please request the sandbox link. (Because I'm not allowed to post it unless somebody asks)
